summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with parametrized tests covering every valid form and error branch. Ran the new tests together with test/test_path.py: 41 passed. Nothing was committed. Not verified: black, isort, ruff, and mypy are not installed in the prepared venv, so the type-check gate was checked by reading only. One risk: the isinstance(path_identifier, Node) guard may trigger a mypy unreachable warning because the parameter is typed as Node.
